metrics.primary: ALL-gold coverage of the served set on split A (all gold nodes of the query covered), per level, per variant, per cache
metrics.paired: exact McNemar vs the QMAX chain at the same level (gained, lost, p); GAIN/LOSS/NEUTRAL labels at alpha 0.01; per hop

decision_rule_pre_registered.m_star(L): the smallest ladder m such that FPS_m PRESERVES at level L on ALL five DEV_A caches; None if no ladder point does
decision_rule_pre_registered.headline: the PRIMARY level (the composite end to end): label FPS_PRESERVES_QMAX_AT_m=<m*> or NO_FPS_LADDER_POINT_PRESERVES_QMAX (m* > 32); ALONE, F0 and SAFE reported with the same rule
decision_rule_pre_registered.also_reported (same rule, not a decision: CENT_MEAN, CENT_NORM per level and cache; m*_RAND per level; whether FPS preserves from m* upward (a non-monotone ladder is flagged, not repaired); binding caches

honest_scope_stated_now.where_the_test_bites: QMAX's gain over the same level without stage 2 is small on four of the five caches (query counts F0 / SAFE / PRIMARY): metaqa [-7, -3, -1]; squad [6, 3, 3]; musique [72, 36, 33]; metaqa_phg [2, -6, -2]; squad_phg [6, 1, 1].  There PRESERVES mostly tests that a cheaper stage 2 does not HURT; the informative cache is musique.
honest_scope_stated_now.compute_caveat: under the current exhaustive dense backend every q . e_v is computed anyway for the node votes, so QMAX is one segmented max over products already paid for; the representative saving is real only with a sublinear dense backend (ANN / IVF-style coarse probing) or when stage 2 must run without the full product.  The run reports vectors scored per query, not wall-clock claims.
honest_scope_stated_now.exhaustive_backend_fact: QMAX itself costs N dot products per query here (N = corpus nodes); CENT costs npart; FPS_m costs <= m * npart
